summary: An instance's main component is not in the file, so it cannot follow its main.
A fill or stroke shows an image the file does not hold, so it draws nothing.
A prototype interaction goes to a layer, or sets a variable or collection, that the file no longer has.
A prototype flow starts at a frame that is not on its page.
A fixed-size text layer's text runs past the bottom of its box.
Text contrasts with the solid colour behind it less than WCAG AA asks (4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text).
A layer is bound to a variable the file does not have, so the value no longer follows it.
A layer uses a style the file does not have, so it no longer follows it.
A visible layer lies wholly outside the frame that clips it, so it never shows.
A main component has no layers and paints nothing, so its instances show nothing.
Text names a font this kit does not have, so it is drawn (and previewed) with a substitute.
A truncating text layer cuts its text off with an ellipsis.
A solid colour equals a colour variable's value but is not bound to it.
A local style is used by no layer.
A layer's position or size is not on whole pixels, so its edges render blurred.
A layer in an auto layout frame ignores the layout (absolute position), so the layout does not move it.
A text layer has no text.
A frame has no layers and paints nothing.
A code was found more often than the check lists; the rest are counted.
